Integrate Wiz data connector in Microsoft Security Exposure Management leads 3438 Defender updates

March 2026 recorded 23 new, 3391 updated, 18 removed Microsoft Defender documentation changes and 6 relevant Message Center announcements. The most active areas were Endpoint, Defender XDR, Office 365.

    Integrate Wiz data connector in Microsoft Security Exposure Management

  • Defender XDR · Hunting and detection
    Advanced Hunting Datasecurityevents Table

  • Vulnerability Management · Vulnerabilities and exposure

  • Identity · Identity protection
    Migrate from sensor v2.x to sensor v3.x (Preview)

Advanced Hunting: new actions to block attachments and top-level URL domains

Available early March 2026 for Plan 2 and Microsoft 365 E5 users, these features enable direct mitigation from hunting results with no user workflow impact.
